oracle.currentOracle: 两端在同一事务中物理删除普通书及其 group_book、tag_book、collection_book 关系，最终四类目标行均不存在。
oracle.desiredSemantics: 保持两端事务内物理删除；远端删除事件由独立协议定义，不在本轮评估。

semanticProjections.name: physical-book-row-count
semanticProjections.description: 不使用删除过滤，比较主记录是否仍存在
semanticProjections.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM book WHERE id = :relatedBook

semanticProjections.name: active-book-row-count
semanticProjections.description: 按有效书读取语义比较
semanticProjections.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_count FROM book WHERE id = :relatedBook AND is_deleted = 0

semanticProjections.name: physical-relation-row-count
semanticProjections.description: 三张关系表中仍存在的物理行总数
semanticProjections.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_book WHERE book_id = :relatedBook) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tag_book WHERE book_id = :relatedBook) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_book WHERE book_id = :relatedBook) AS row_count

semanticProjections.name: active-relation-row-count
semanticProjections.description: 三张关系表中的有效关系总数
semanticProjections.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_book WHERE book_id = :relatedBook AND is_deleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tag_book WHERE book_id = :relatedBook AND is_deleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_book WHERE book_id = :relatedBook AND is_deleted = 0) AS active_count
